response.original_title: Space Art : Des artistes à la conquête de l’espace
response.overview: Space Art is a documentary for France 3 that sits at the intersection of art and science, inviting viewers to discover a highly distinctive artistic genre. Behind every science-fiction spacecraft in Star Wars, every science-fiction novel cover, and even every NASA “artist’s impression” of a black hole, lies a mysterious form of art : Space Art. Artists in this field dedicate themselves to imagining the unseen facets of the universe and its future, complete with extraordinary technological advancements. For decades, they have given shape to our dreams of exploration.
